map.肾功能评估临床要点: Clinical points for kidney function assessment
map.• 高血压、糖尿病患者（每年至少1次）: • Hypertension, diabetes patients (at least once a year)
map.• 水肿、泡沫尿、血尿等症状: • Edema, foamy urine, hematuria and other symptoms
map.• 血肌酐（Scr）：最常用，受肌肉量影响: • Serum creatinine (Scr): most common, affected by muscle mass
map.• 尿素氮（BUN）：受饮食、脱水影响大: • Blood urea nitrogen (BUN): greatly affected by diet and dehydration
map.• 尿酸（UA）：痛风、肾病相关: • Uric acid (UA): linked to gout and kidney disease
map.• 胱抑素C（CysC）：更敏感，不受肌肉影响: • Cystatin C (CysC): more sensitive, unaffected by muscle
map.• 尿常规：蛋白尿、血尿是肾损伤早期信号: • Urinalysis: proteinuria and hematuria are early signs of kidney injury
map.• eGFR是估算值，精确测量需菊粉清除试验: • eGFR is an estimate; precise measurement needs inulin clearance
map.• 老年人、肌肉萎缩者血肌酐可能正常但GFR已下降: • Elderly and those with muscle atrophy may have normal creatinine but decreased GFR
map.• 孕妇、儿童需要专用公式: • Pregnant women and children need dedicated formulas
map.• 肾功能异常需结合尿常规、影像学综合判断: • Abnormal kidney function needs comprehensive judgment with urinalysis and imaging
map.• 每日饮水1500-2000ml，不要憋尿: • Drink 1500-2000 ml daily; do not hold urine
map.• 少量多次，不要等到口渴才喝: • Small amounts often; do not wait until thirsty
map.• 肾功能不全者遵医嘱限水: • Those with impaired kidney function limit fluids as advised
map.• 低盐饮食：每日＜5g盐: • Low-salt diet: less than 5 g salt per day
map.• 多吃蔬果，少吃高脂高嘌呤食物: • Eat more vegetables and fruit; less high-fat, high-purine food
map.• 肾病患者需低蛋白饮食请遵医嘱: • Kidney patients need low-protein diet as advised
map.• 不滥用止痛药、抗生素、偏方: • Do not abuse painkillers, antibiotics or folk remedies
map.• 用药前阅读说明书，注意肾毒性: • Read the label before use; note nephrotoxicity
map.• 肾功能不全者就医时告知医生: • Tell the doctor if you have impaired kidney function
map.• 避免熬夜和过度劳累: • Avoid staying up late and overwork
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不能替代医疗诊断。肾功能异常请及时就医，肾脏病患者请遵医嘱: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only and cannot replace medical diagnosis. For abnormal kidney function, seek medical advice promptly; kidney patients follow medical advice for treatment.

map.eGFR 正常就代表肾脏完全健康吗？: Does normal eGFR mean the kidneys are fully healthy?
map.不一定。eGFR 反映滤过率，早期肾损伤（如微量白蛋白尿、肾小球硬化）可出现在: Not necessarily. eGFR reflects filtration rate; early kidney injury (e.g. microalbuminuria, glomerular sclerosis) can appear while eGFR is still normal. Assessing kidney health also needs urine albumin/creatinine ratio, blood pressure and imaging, not eGFR alone.
